name: GMS Industries (El Paso ops)
description: GMS Industries is a family-owned packaging manufacturer that began in 1989 and is run by brothers Kris and Cory Glidden as CEO and COO. With production in the United States and Mexico, it makes pressure sensitive labels, printed instruction sheets, folding cartons, corrugated and laminate shipping boxes, rigid setup boxes and printed paper bags. Label work includes freezer- and cold-chain-rated adhesives, roll and sheet formats, and variable data printing. The company supplies food and beverage, consumer packaged goods, pharmaceutical and nutraceutical, cosmetics, home and hardware, and retail brands, and holds a GSA federal schedule.
